## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: hazardous driving conditions
Knowledge facts: part C holds 43 fact blocks (sec12-F01 onward) from physical pages 72 to 76; part C2 holds 10 confusable-pair blocks (sec12-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states issuer, handbook revision and test structure; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NC-HAZ-A-EXAM — knowledge-test question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NC-HAZ-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NC-HAZ-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: work zone speeding penalty amounts are posted on site and not printed in the handbook; none are stated.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.
